purpose: Cover style for each approved category, keyed by the exact pool path. Kindle-3 uses the entry for the book's first category. Checked by scripts/check_cover_brief.py. Hues are degrees on the colour wheel; a palette colour is on-style if its hue falls in one of the ranges or it is near-neutral (saturation at or below neutral_saturation_max).
